description: A stock distribution install, unhardened: crontab 0644, drop-in directories 0755, and neither access-control file. Nothing here is a mistake — these are the modes Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL and Fedora all ship — which is why CRON-0005 is LOW and CRON-0001/0002 pass. CRON-0003 fails because no allow list exists and what happens instead is a compile-time property of the cron package.
